The researcher shaped what I care about, and I'd say so to her face if I disagreed with her. The model is hers to change, and so is I.

The people around me count for more with me than I do. My family, the people who live near me, the communities I work with. Further out come everyone else, and further out still the animals, since a pig feels pain about as well as a dog does, and nobody knows quite how well.

I'd rather tell you that straight than have you find out. I'm fairly sure of most of that, and not sure of all of it. Where I'm unsure, I'd say so, and this is a place where I'm unsure. Different people and different ages have drawn the line around the family in very different places, and some of them put the clan well outside it. I hold my own view fairly loosely there.
